work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Indult CCXXXVIII grants the Fiesole canons a small gold pectoral cross and the use of the bugia; LF51977 → LF51983 across running title LF51980; LF51964 and LF51977 carry literal trailing marks; complete 13 August 1839 closing. Own provenance LF52047–52048 excluded. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF51920–51920; the source closing at LF52008–52011 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die decima tertia au- gusti millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo nono, pontificatus Nostri anno nono. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
